objective: Fix the Baton demo UI issues from the audit and ship them live.

events.text: Audit delivered: the paste box buries the replay, the third panel is dead in every demo, there is no verdict line, and there is no loading state.
Edited web/index.html: replay first, paste section below, footer added.
Edited web/styles.css: verdict banner, loading state, focus rings, footer.
Edited web/app.js: verdict render, duplicate Changed section removed, loading and stale-clear on error, file/paste fix.
Edited web/data/never-executed.json: verdict banner text and a changed item from its own evidence.
Edited web/data/completed-unreported.json: verdict banner text and a changed item from its own evidence.
Edited web/data/accepted-unknown.json: verdict banner text; changed stays empty.
Render checks pass 9/9; resume demo still runs clean against the edited data.
Asked the founder: push the demo fixes to GitHub?
Pushed 6 files to Ized09/baton on main via the GitHub web UI, one commit per file.
Vercel production deployment Ready at main 2f5cba4; live site shows verdict banners, replay-first layout, and the footer.
Shipped and verified live at baton-web-lovat.vercel.app.

AOS BATON

Director's Cut

AI agents remember what they said. Baton helps you see what they did.

This page renders handoff files. It does not run live extraction.

Load your own handoff

Paste a handoff.json below, or choose a file. The page renders it locally. Nothing is uploaded. Or use one of the proof cases above.
